description: This file contains unit tests for the ConnectionManager class in the Android app, specifically testing TLS parameter resolution, gateway host recognition, and node connection option building with various configurations.

classes.name: ConnectionManagerTest
classes.description: Test suite for the ConnectionManager class, verifying TLS resolution, gateway host checks, and node connection options based on feature availability and configurations.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_prefersStoredPinOverAdvertisedFingerprint
methods.description: Tests that when a stored fingerprint is available, it is preferred over an advertised fingerprint in TLS params.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_doesNotTrustAdvertisedFingerprintWhenNoStoredPin
methods.description: Verifies that no expected fingerprint is set when no stored fingerprint is provided.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_manualRespectsManualTlsToggle
methods.description: Checks that manual TLS enablement respects the manualTlsEnabled parameter.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_manualNonLoopbackForcesTlsWhenToggleIsOff
methods.description: Ensures TLS is required for non-loopback manual endpoints when manual TLS toggle is off.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_manualPrivateLanCanStayCleartextWhenToggleIsOff
methods.description: Validates that private LAN endpoints can remain cleartext when manual TLS is disabled.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryTailnetWithoutHintsStillRequiresTls
methods.description: Checks that discovery endpoints without hints still require TLS.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryPrivateLanWithoutHintsCanStayCleartext
methods.description: Verifies private LAN endpoints can stay cleartext in discovery mode without hints.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryLoopbackWithoutHintsCanStayCleartext
methods.description: Ensures loopback endpoints can stay cleartext without hints.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryLocalhostWithoutHintsCanStayCleartext
methods.description: Checks that localhost endpoints can stay cleartext without hints.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryAndroidEmulatorWithoutHintsCanStayCleartext
methods.description: Verifies that Android emulator host can stay cleartext without hints.

methods.name: isLoopbackGatewayHost_onlyTreatsEmulatorBridgeAsLocalWhenAllowed
methods.description: Tests behavior of isLoopbackGatewayHost for emulator bridge addresses with toggle.

methods.name: isPrivateLanGatewayHost_acceptsLanHostsButRejectsTailnetHosts
methods.description: Validates recognition of private LAN gateway hosts vs tailnet hosts.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryIpv6LoopbackWithoutHintsCanStayCleartext
methods.description: Checks IPv6 loopback endpoints can remain cleartext.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryMappedIpv4LoopbackWithoutHintsCanStayCleartext
methods.description: Ensures mapped IPv4 loopback addresses stay cleartext.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryNonLoopbackIpv6WithoutHintsRequiresTls
methods.description: Verifies non-loopback IPv6 endpoints require TLS.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryUnspecifiedIpv4WithoutHintsRequiresTls
methods.description: Checks that unspecified IPv4 addresses require TLS.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryUnspecifiedIpv6WithoutHintsRequiresTls
methods.description: Ensures unspecified IPv6 addresses require TLS.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions_advertisesSmsCapabilityWhenReadSmsIsAvailable

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions_advertisesAvailableNonSmsCommandsAndCapabilities

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions_omitsVoiceWakeWithoutMicrophonePermission
